Runtime transfer function changes without texture regeneration.
-   **When to Use:** Large volume datasets, dynamic transfer functions, GPU with limited texture memory but high rasterization throughput.
-   **When Not to Use:** Small volumes fitting in texture memory without bricking.
The method addresses bottlenecks in GPU volume rendering by combining bricking and octree traversal.
Bricking was previously used by Tong et al. [TWTT99], but required texture regeneration for transfer function changes.
